body:
2026年9月20日，美国阳翥道教协会会长吉法新受邀以特别来宾、道教信仰领袖身份参加北美印度庙协会举行的大型印度教宗教文化庆典，与印度教信仰领袖、社区代表及各界嘉宾共同参与活动。

此次庆典举行了 Śri Ganeśa Ratha Yātra（甘尼萨神战车巡游）等传统宗教仪式及庆祝活动，吸引众多信众和社区民众参加，集中展现了印度教悠久的宗教传统与文化传承。

活动期间，吉法新会长作为道教信仰领袖与印度教宗教人士及社区代表进行了友好交流，并介绍了道教文化以及美国阳翥道教协会在美国开展道教文化传播、跨宗教交流和社区服务等方面的工作。

美国阳翥道教协会重视与不同宗教传统之间的交流与相互理解。此次参加印度教大型传统庆典，进一步增进了道教与印度教信仰社区之间的友好联系，也为不同宗教文化在美国多元社会中的交流与合作提供了良好契机。

未来，美国阳翥道教协会将继续积极参与跨宗教交流与社会文化活动，向美国社会及国际社会介绍道教传统与文化，促进不同信仰之间的理解、尊重与友谊。
body_en:
On September 20, 2026, Dpr. Zhouxinyu Ji, President of the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America, was invited to attend a major Hindu religious and cultural celebration organized by the Hindu Temple Society of North America as a Special Guest and Taoist Faith Leader, joining Hindu religious leaders, community representatives, and distinguished guests for the occasion.

The celebration featured the traditional Śri Ganeśa Ratha Yātra and other religious ceremonies and festivities, bringing together a large number of devotees and members of the community while highlighting the rich religious traditions and cultural heritage of Hinduism.

During the event, Dpr. Zhouxinyu Ji engaged in friendly exchanges with Hindu religious leaders and community representatives. He also introduced Taoist culture and shared the work of the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America in promoting Taoist culture, interfaith engagement, and community service in the United States.

The Yangzhu Taoist Association of America values dialogue, mutual understanding, and friendship among different religious traditions. Participation in this important Hindu celebration further strengthened connections between Taoist and Hindu faith communities and provided another meaningful opportunity for interfaith and intercultural exchange in the diverse society of the United States.

The Yangzhu Taoist Association of America will continue to participate actively in interfaith and cultural initiatives, introduce Taoist traditions and culture to broader American and international audiences, and promote understanding, respect, and friendship among different faith communities.
